comment: Relocatable CPython builds from python-build-standalone (astral-sh), the install_only variant. The release tag pins the exact build; the checksums come from the release's SHA256SUMS file and are verified before anything is extracted.

linux-x86_64.name: cpython-3.12.15+20261013-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-install_only.tar.gz
linux-x86_64.comment: Only used on the build machine, to write .pyc files with Python 3.12's magic number and to run the packaged pure-Python code under 3.12.
